response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with 13+ years across web, backend, mobile and embedded work, a CS degree, and one strong high-scale credential (low-latency microservices handling millions of requests/second at Sociomantic/dunnhumby). However, the role is a Principal/IC6 position centered on growth and experimentation systems, and the resume shows no evidence of A/B testing frameworks, feature flighting, telemetry/metrics infrastructure, statistical analysis, or guardrail/bias-detection work. There is also little demonstrated principal-level scope: no multi-workstream initiatives, cross-org influence, or platform ownership used by many teams, and recent roles are at small companies rather than enterprise scale. Strong craftsmanship and community/teaching background are pluses, but the core domain gap is too large for a principal hire without significant ramp-up.
strengths: Broad 13+ year engineering range with high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems experience
Strong testing/quality craftsmanship (TDD, CI/CD, built test runner and assertion libraries)
Open-source founder, conference speaker, and workshop instructor — evidence of mentoring and communication
concerns: No demonstrated experimentation, feature-flagging, or growth-measurement platform experience
Limited data/statistics aptitude — no metrics, telemetry, or experimental analysis track record
Scope reads senior/staff IC at small companies, not principal-level cross-org leadership at enterprise scale

key_factors.factor: Insufficient principal-level scope and cross-team influence
Deep polyglot engineering experience incl. high-scale services
